sources.title: Installing Qwen 3.5 on Apple Silicon Using MLX for 2X Performance
sources.snippet: Enter Qwen 3.5 MLX in the search field. Select a model (0.8B ,2B ,4B ,9B) explicitly labeled as MLX. - By default, LLM Studio is capable of displaying which models your device is capable of running. sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B-MLX-4bit: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.5-9B-MLX-4bit is a quantized vision-language model optimized exclusively for Apple Silicon. It converts the original Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B to 4-bit quantization with a group size of 64 using the MLX framework, reducing the model to approximately 5.6 GB on disk while maintaining image-to-text reasoning capabilities.
